experience.body: Worked on a Puja campaign, supported the launch of FL SHIFT, and contributed to creative direction, visual storytelling, and fashion campaign execution.

Co-hosted the 17th DRMC National Science & Codeavour International Carnival 2026, welcoming 50,000+ visitors and 10,000+ participants. Hosted seven seminars and workshops and helped organize DRMC’s inaugural TEDx Talk.
Selected from 40+ candidates to oversee 500+ students. Led weekly assemblies as Parade Commander and connected students, faculty, and prefect teams.
Founded a social organization and led eight community projects, including wall art, awareness campaigns, and food drives. Coordinated people and operations from the ground up.
Produced documentary films and short-form reels on a project basis. Contributed to campaigns for 10 Minute School, bKash, Pathao, and ARKA Fashion Week.

Contributed to six major national and international events across production, marketing, gaming, and operations. Hosted gaming tournaments and a DJ battle, produced promotional films, and coordinated event logistics.

awards: Notre Dame Annual Science Festival & 32nd GKC
